lane: mobile Auth UI and internal QA packaging
goal: Improve privacy-preserving signup guidance, local email format validation, near-email sign-in entry and direct confirmation-to-recovery navigation with retained email.
successCriteria: Invalid email format is reported locally while editing, clears when valid, and triggers no Auth request.
Signup form always offers a near-email sign-in entry; email survives navigation.
Generic confirmation and resend copy accurately distinguishes request acceptance from delivery and offers Sign in/Forgot password in VI/EN.
Recovery navigation sends no email until explicit submit; password cleared and active-request intent guard retained.
TypeScript, Auth regressions, data/brand validation and web/native packaging evidence pass; handset acceptance recorded separately.
untouchedSurfaces: AccountBoundary, SDK Auth adapters, session/account isolation, storage, SMTP/templates/callbacks, backend/RLS/schema, Admin/Growth, entitlements, brand assets, production target and dependencies.

impact.entryPoint: Signup email field offers local format feedback and sign-in; generic pending confirmation offers direct sign-in and recovery, retaining email.
impact.dataWrite: Only component-local form state and sanitized build/test evidence; recovery call remains explicit existing action. No new persistent data, backend account lookup or database write.
impact.backendContract: Existing signup/resend/recovery adapter methods and exact QA target remain unchanged. No new endpoint, queue, schema or credential.
impact.adminVisibility: No new private account visibility or metrics; internal sanitized owner report only.
impact.privacySafety: Keep anti-enumeration semantics and generic recovery responses. Never label a specific address as registered or delivered from generic SDK200. No automatic reset or new email during QA.
impact.observability: Synthetic VI/EN UI tests and export/native source checks distinguish compile evidence from delivery/device acceptance. No address/token logging.
impact.rollback: Reverse only this bounded AuthFlow patch or reinstall preserved prior QA APK; no data clearing, migrations or cloud rollback needed.

canonicalContracts: AuthFlow.tsx owns VI/EN Auth copy and component-local navigation; existing AuthView types and callbacks remain canonical.
supabaseAuth.ts owns exact existing signup/resend/recovery and generic duplicate-account contract; reviewed, unchanged.
Existing QA internal build helpers public env allowlist; release runbook/profile still gate cloud/store release.
